results.title: East China refunds: company-wide summary (Q3)
results.content: Refunds in East China rose noticeably in Q3, mostly from September, while other regions stayed flat (b-101, b-103). Support saw refund-related tickets roughly triple in September, mainly from customers who said they were charged twice or charged after a failed payment (b-207). A payment update released on Sep 12 may be linked, but this is unverified and the cause is not confirmed (b-318, unverified). Customers can request refunds within 30 days from the Orders page, with money returned in 5-7 business days (b-208). Exact rates and internal details are left out of this public version.
